notes: Fitted 2026-11-16 by calibrate_grid_sim.py (T-060) from the 19 dry 2026 races. pace.* regress real clean-air race pace on the sim's own pace inputs (scale 1): race_pace_scale is the slope, quali_weight the share of the Q1 gap vs the quantile-matched rating order, driver_shrink the pull toward the team mean, *_pace_sd_s the variance components of the residual net of the pace-estimate sampling variance. sc.gap_s / closure: bunching behind the SC (floor and per-lap decay of the median car-to-car gap). lap1_spacing_s: slope of gap-to-leader at the end of lap 1 per position. strategy_mix: share of real strategies nearest to the optimizer's top-3 plans and the half-width of the per-stop jitter. overtake_calibration: pace_delta_scale multiplies the pace delta in the overtake logit, intercept_shift is added to the intercept, held_gap_s is the gap a car is held at after a failed pass (real median); scale/shift chosen to match real passes per race (T-053 definition, all events) and the spread of grid->finish position change.
